scope: Stable native card-stat tooltips plus retained production pointer routing at 1920 by 1080 and 1280 by 720

checks.name: live controller and Slate available
isolated training match accepts input
four production Slate hand buttons
troop or building card available for legal and illegal drops
legal arena target projects to its actual board tile
hand geometry is arranged and lies outside deployment area
hovering hand card opens its production Slate stats tooltip
unchanged hand hover keeps the same tooltip open through twelve HUD refreshes
hand press selects and owns pointer capture
small pointer motion remains a selection click
simple card click selects without spending or cycling
drag threshold and ghost survive an earlier queued viewport release
returning to original hand card remains a drag
return to hand cancels and preserves full match state
release over HUD cancels without spending or cycling
release over illegal enemy tile cancels without spending or cycling
release outside viewport cancels without edge deployment
right click cancels captured drag and later release cannot rearm
Escape cancels first without opening battle menu
lost pointer capture cancels without spending or cycling
application focus loss cancels without spending or cycling
opening pause modal cancels before its later release
unaffordable drag returns to hand without mutation
click deployment preference does not accidentally drag deploy
changing keyboard selection cancels the old pointer transaction
legal drop spends exactly one card cost
legal drop cycles the selected slot exactly once
legal drop creates the selected troop or building
legal drop clears capture selection ghost and preview transaction
duplicate mouse release cannot spend or cycle again
cycling a hand card refreshes its stats tooltip once and keeps the new hover open
finished phase cancels a pending drag without deployment
